title: Especialista em CTI e SOAR – Fortinet
description:
️ Vaga | Especialista em CTI e SOAR – Operação SOC | Projeto Setor Elétrico – Campinas/SP (Modelo Híbrido) Faça parte da expansão da Ekballo IT !!!

A Ekballo IT está em fase de expansão com a implantação de um SOC (Security Operations Center) especializado em atender ambientes críticos e altamente regulados, com foco em empresas do setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações .

Nosso compromisso é garantir total aderência aos requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios exigidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e pelas boas práticas do setor elétrico .

Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) e SOAR , com experiência comprovada, para atuar em operações de missão crítica, garantindo segurança, rastreabilidade e conformidade de ponta a ponta.

Responsabilidades:
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, operação e evolução do SOC da Ekballo IT, com foco em ambientes críticos do setor elétrico;
  • Desenvolver, testar e operar playbooks de automação (SOAR) e processos robustos de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) , alinhados aos padrões técnicos e regulatórios;
  • Assegurar a aderência total aos requisitos estabelecidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas aplicáveis ao segmento de transmissão de energia e subestações ;
  • Produzir documentação técnica rastreável, auditável e aderente aos processos regulatórios e operacionais;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de mobilização técnica , respeitando os cronogramas acordados com o cliente, garantindo a entrega de todos os artefatos técnicos exigidos.
Atividades Técnicas: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI):
  • Coletar, processar e enriquecer informações de ameaças (OSINT, FortiGuard, ISACs e outros feeds);
  • Correlacionar IOCs com eventos detectados no FortiSIEM, FortiEDR e ferramentas do ecossistema Fortinet;
  • Mapear TTPs com base nos frameworks MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model e Kill Chain ;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos que suportem análises de riscos cibernéticos voltadas ao setor elétrico;
  • Alimentar o FortiSOAR com dados estruturados (STIX, TAXII, CSV, JSON) para automação de respostas;
  • Atuar em threat hunting , priorizando riscos e ameaças relacionadas a ambientes OT e sistemas críticos.
️ Automação e Orquestração (SOAR):
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter playbooks no FortiSOAR , garantindo aderência técnica e regulatória;
  • Realizar integrações do FortiSOAR com FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiMail, FortiWeb, FortiGate, além de sistemas de gestão como ServiceNow e GLPI;
  • Implementar automações que reduzam o tempo de resposta, otimizem o MTTR e fortaleçam a eficiência do SOC;
  • Realizar troubleshooting, ajustes e melhorias nas automações, utilizando APIs, Python, Bash ou PowerShell.
Compromissos Contratuais e Regulatórios:
  • A equipe alocada será composta por profissionais com experiência comprovada no setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações ;
  • Serão apresentados, previamente ao início da operação, atestados de capacidade técnica, currículos detalhados e certificações profissionais , em alinhamento com o cronograma de mobilização e validação técnica definido com o cliente;
  • Todos os profissionais serão previamente validados para atuação em ambientes regulados , garantindo aderência total às exigências do ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas do setor ;
  • A Ekballo IT assegura rastreabilidade técnica e regulatória de toda a equipe e dos processos, garantindo uma operação completamente auditável e aderente aos padrões exigidos.
Requisitos Técnicos:
  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento e operação de playbooks no FortiSOAR ;
  • Domínio das ferramentas Fortinet: FortiSOAR, FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate, FortiMail, FortiWeb ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Threat Intelligence, IOC Enrichment, STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT&CK, YARA ;
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica, preferencialmente no setor elétrico (diferencial altamente valorizado);
  • Habilidade em automação de processos, integrações via API e desenvolvimento de scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell);
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos normativos e regulatórios aplicáveis ao setor de transmissão de energia (diferencial).
Formação e Certificações:
  • Graduação completa em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Redes ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações Obrigatórias:
  • Fortinet NSE 4 – FortiGate Security
  • Fortinet NSE 5 – FortiSIEM / FortiSOAR
  • Certificações Desejáveis:
  • NSE 6 – FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer
  • NSE 7 – Advanced Threat Protection
  • Outras certificações: CySA+, CTIA, GCTI, CEH, GCIA, GNFA, SANS
Modelo de Contrato e Jornada:
  • Regime: CLT (Efetivo)
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (Presencial em Campinas/SP + Home Office)
  • Escala: 5x2 , com atuação sob regime de plantão e sobreaviso , conforme cronograma técnico do projeto e exigências operacionais.
O que oferecemos:
  • Participação na implantação e operação do SOC da Ekballo IT , com foco em ambientes críticos do setor elétrico (transmissão e subestações);
  • Ambiente colaborativo, especializado e orientado a excelência técnica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional e evolução para posições de liderança técnica ou gestão;
  • Incentivo à capacitação e obtenção de certificações profissionais;
  • Pacote de benefícios competitivo e alinhado ao mercado (detalhado no processo seletivo).
Faça parte dessa transformação!

title: Creator Marketing Specialist
description:
Creator Marketing Specialist

Influeri is a fast-moving scale-up transforming creator marketing through automation and AI. We help global brands launch creator campaigns at scale - faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever. Our technology eliminates the manual work from influencer marketing, making it easy to match, activate, and manage creator campaigns across markets. At the core of Influeri is a growing ecosystem of content creators from all over the world - enabling brands to connect with the right voices, in the right places, at the right time. Now, we’re ready to scale even further.

Type: Full-time freelancer

Industry: Creator Marketing / Campaign Operations

Your Role

You’ll work closely with our campaign management team to coordinate influencer marketing and UGC campaigns in Brazil - from creator selection and client onboarding to reviewing content and ensuring timely delivery. You’ll also act as a key point of contact for Brazilian companies and support international campaigns when needed. You’ll be responsible for creating stunning campaigns together with clients, supporting creators in their creative processes, analyzing social media trends, and preparing clear, professional client presentations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support campaign setup, creator support, and coordination
  • Create effective and creative influencer marketing and UGC strategies
  • Review content and ensure campaign guidelines are followed
  • Monitor deadlines, performance, and deliverables
  • Act as a point of contact for Brazilian companies and creators
  • Support international campaigns when required
  • Analyze social media metrics and campaign performance
  • Organize and host client meetings and client pitches
  • Translate and localize campaign materials when needed

You Have

  • At least 1 year of experience working with influencer marketing and UGC campaigns
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Native Brazilian Portuguese and fluent English
  • Comfortable communicating with both creators and brands
  • Confident using social media analytics tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite, TikTok analytics, or similar)
  • Experience with presentation tools
  • A proactive, detail-oriented, and problem-solving mindset

We Offer

  • Full-time freelance contract
  • Remote work with flexible hours
  • Hands-on experience with global brands and marketing agencies
  • A chance to grow with the most innovative company in the creator marketing space

A pessoa da vaga ficará responsável por participar e liderar as iniciativas de branding dentro de um ou mais squads de produto do marketing.

O Marketing da Webmotors é divido em 4 frentes diferentes: (1) Branding, (2) Aquisição e Engajamento, (3) Content Marketing e (4) Criação. A pessoa que estamos buscando deve ter organização, espírito criativo e boa comunicação para transitar e solicitar as ações em cada frente de trabalho diferente. Com certeza os desafios serão dinâmicos, divertidos e desafiadores.

•Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de branding alinhadas ao posicionamento e propósito da marca no segmento B2B do mercado automotivo;

•Planejar e executar campanhas e ações de comunicação voltadas para parceiros, clientes corporativos e stakeholders estratégicos;

•Projetos de comunicação: implementar, em conjunto com a squad de trabalho e áreas correlatas, projetos relativos à nossa frente de trabalho;

•Participar e contribuir com iniciativas dentro da squad de trabalho voltada ao público B2B, que abrange oficinas, lojas de veículos, concessionárias, montadoras, mercado aftermarket etc

•Colaborar com todas as equipes de marketing, vendas e produto para garantir consistência e impacto nas iniciativas de marca;

•Analisar tendências de mercado e concorrência, trazendo insights para posicionamento e diferenciação da marca;

•Analisar, mensurar e reportar a performance das iniciativas de branding B2B, utilizando métricas e KPIs relevantes e retroalimentando a estratégia das ações subsequentes;

•Gerenciar a identidade visual e verbal da marca em materiais direcionados ao público corporativo, interno e externo;

•Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas para fortalecer a presença da marca no mercado.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.

JOB TEMPLATE

Procurement Executive Manager (Raw Materials, Packaging & TPM)

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development of category strategies within cross-functional teams, ensuring they are based on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles.
  • Review the overall effectiveness of current strategies, identify additional opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Clearly articulate the category vision and improvement roadmap to stakeholders, inspiring engagement and promoting cross-functional collaboration.
  • Secure approval for all category strategies within your scope of responsibility.
  • Monitor strategy progress and adapt as needed based on the evolving business environment.
  • Ensure business needs are fully addressed.
  • Facilitate collaboration between category teams, internal stakeholders, and suppliers to support product testing and evaluation.
  • Drive strong buy-in and influence key decisions to support the successful implementation and sustainability of initiatives.
  • Lead cost reduction initiatives and track ongoing improvements.
  • Monitor execution, adjust plans as needed, and maintain momentum across teams.
  • Ensure governance and compliance in all aspects of category and contract management.
  • Oversee financial strategies and pricing reviews in collaboration with category leads.
  • Align sourcing strategies with Global Commodity Leaders.
  • Support procurement and cross-functional teams in the development and execution of key projects.

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Guide and challenge negotiation strategies with suppliers.
  • Manage relationships with senior-level supplier stakeholders.
  • Ensure strategic alignment with peer managers.
  • Facilitate effective communication between end users and the supply market.
  • Identify benchmarking opportunities and drive competitive insights.

People Management

  • Set priorities and provide guidance to the team.
  • Promote collaboration between team members and across procurement functions for strategic categories.
  • Ensure compliance with systems, policies, and procedures.
  • Secure adequate resources to meet category team goals.
  • Direct category teams and manage individual performance through clear goal setting and reviews.
  • Foster effective communication within the team and create a positive work environment.
  • Build team credibility through high service standards and issue resolution.
  • Identify training and development needs and arrange appropriate learning opportunities.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing.
  • Expertise in cost management and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Solid knowledge of negotiation techniques, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), and Strategic Sourcing.
  • Strong understanding of the market and key suppliers within the category.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications (nice to have)

  • Prior experience with SAP/Ariba systems.
  • Advanced Spanish skills.

Behavioral Skills

  • Strong leadership to inspire and guide teams to deliver outstanding results.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to think critically and challenge the status quo.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented approach with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Resilience and composure under pressure.
  • Business acumen focused on sustainable and profitable results.

BENEFITS

  • Performance-based bonus.
  • Extended Parental Leave (180 days for mothers and fathers).
  • Birthday off.
  • Parking.
  • Medical and Dental Insurance.
  • Group Life Insurance.
  • Optional Group Personal Accident Insurance.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you\'ll do

As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards.
  • Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices.
  • Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations.
  • Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational.
  • Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines.
  • Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools.
  • Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.

Requirements

  • Completed Technical Degree in Electronics.
  • Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas.
  • Enrollment in a Bachelor\u2019s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading.
  • Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware.
  • Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions).
  • Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.).
  • Intermediate English fluency.
  • Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python.
  • Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C.
  • Experience with other low-level programming languages.
  • Fluency in English proficiency.

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years

title: Hardware Troubleshooting Technician
description:
Overview

Hardware Troubleshooting Technician role at TRACTIAN

Join to apply for the Hardware Troubleshooting Technician role at TRACTIAN. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you\'ll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

The Hardware team

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What You'll Do

As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards.
  • Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices.
  • Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations.
  • Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational.
  • Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines.
  • Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools.
  • Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.

Requirements

  • Completed Technical Degree in Electronics.
  • Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas.
  • Enrollment in a Bachelor\'s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading.
  • Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware.
  • Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions).
  • Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.).
  • Intermediate English fluency.
  • Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python.
  • Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C.
  • Experience with other low-level programming languages.
  • Fluency in English proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Seniority level

  • Entry level

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Information Technology

title: CAE Engineer
description:
Why join us
TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

As a CAE Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and run FEM analyses: linear/nonlinear static, modal transient, random, frequency response, explicit, durability.
  • Analyze vibrational behavior, derive FRFs, and interpret mode shapes to optimize performance.
  • Apply DOE, response surfaces, optimization, and uncertainty analyses to explore design space and quantify risk.
  • Plan and perform tests for model correlation and validation.
  • Partner with test teams on accelerated life testing, translating field data into test requirements and simulation inputs.
  • Script pre/post-processing (Python, MATLAB) to scale studies and improve modeling quality.
  • Document standards, templates, and best practices; propose new methods to capture physics and speed up iteration.
  • Work closely with product development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production teams, guiding decisions with technical data.
  • Deliver clear reports and presentations explaining assumptions, modeling choices, limitations, and design implications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field.
  • Strong understanding of FEM fundamentals, with hands-on experience. Ability to explain model behavior and link results to underlying physics.
  • Experience in test-based model calibration/validation and correlating simulation with experimental data.
  • Knowledge of fatigue analysis and durability assessment.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for data processing, automation, and custom tool development.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment.
  • Proactive, self-directed learner who goes beyond the brief to resolve issues.
  • Advanced English level.
  • Live in or have availability to move to São Paulo.

Bonus points

  • Expertise in vibration and structural dynamics.
  • Experience in optimization, robust/stochastic design, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Hands-on experience with FEA pre-processing tools and solvers (e.g., Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, Radioss, HyperMesh/ANSA).

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

description:
Legal Intake Specialist (Brazil | Remote)

About the job

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
  • Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.
  • Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

  • Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that ~90% require adjustments).
  • Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.
  • Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.

3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.
  • Identify and elevate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

title: Junior Product Owner - Brazil
description:
About North Star Network

North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.

Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

About the Role

At North Star Network, we are looking for a Junior Product Owner for our Brazilian Business Unit to support our Product team in delivering high-quality, business-driven digital products.

This role is ideal for someone organized, curious, and eager to grow in Product Management, with a strong interest in digital products, user experience, and data-informed decision-making.

You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Tech, UX, QA, and business stakeholders to help translate business and user needs into clear, actionable product requirements, ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement across our platforms.

Key Responsibilities

1. Backlog Management & Specification

  • Assist in maintaining a structured and organized product backlog.
  • Draft initial user stories and acceptance criteria based on guidance and documented user or business needs.
  • Support refinement sessions with Tech, UX, and stakeholders to clarify requirements.
  • Help assess and communicate feature priorities according to business objectives and constraints.

2. Sprint Preparation & Delivery Support

  • Support backlog grooming sessions by preparing tickets and ensuring required details are available.
  • Clarify straightforward questions from the development team, escalating complex topics to the Product Owner or Product Manager.
  • Help validate completed stories by checking alignment with acceptance criteria.
  • Flag potential requirement gaps, risks, or dependencies to the Product Owner or Product Manager early.

3. Product Quality & Feedback Loop

  • Contribute to ensuring user stories lead to high-quality product increments.
  • Collaborate with QA by supporting test case preparation and helping review defects.
  • Collect basic user feedback, operational insights, or data points to support iteration.
  • Uphold consistency in product behavior and user experience by reporting inconsistencies.

4. Stakeholder Communication

  • Assist in maintaining communication between stakeholders and the development team.
  • Help prepare status updates, release notes, or documentation for internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate small updates or clarifications, while escalating major decisions to the Product Owner or Product Manager.
  • Ensure continuous alignment with the Product Owner and Product Manager on prioritization and scope.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in a Product, Project, Business Analyst, or Tech-related role (or relevant internships).
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to structure information clearly and write concise product documentation.
  • Basic understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies and product development cycles.
  • Analytical mindset with an interest in data, user behavior, and business impact.
  • Comfortable working with cross‑functional, fully remote teams.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken); French or other languages are a plus.
  • Interest in digital media, sports, or iGaming is a strong advantage.

What We Offer

  • A hands‑on Product role with strong learning and growth opportunities.
  • Exposure to international, high‑traffic digital products in sports and betting media.
  • 100% remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones.
  • A multicultural, fast‑growing team passionate about sports, data, and digital innovation.
  • A culture of autonomy, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Competitive salary.

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re eager to grow in Product Management, enjoy working at the intersection of business, tech, and user experience, and want to contribute to impactful digital products we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape the next generation of NSN’s products.

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global.

title: Field Enablement Manager (LATAM)
description:
The Team

Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog’s Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.

As Datadog continues to invest in LATAM, this role represents a foundational hire—helping establish how enablement shows up locally while staying tightly connected to our global enablement ecosystem.

The Opportunity

Datadog is growing quickly across Latin America, and we’re looking for our first Field Enablement Manager based in LATAM to support this momentum. This role will be responsible for delivering ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement for our Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM—particularly for sellers and CSMs based in Brazil and Mexico .

In addition, you’ll support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America (e.g., Boston, Denver, Atlanta) who sell into LATAM accounts. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the field, ensuring global enablement programs land effectively in the local context—across language, culture, sales motion, and market dynamics.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives as an independent operator, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement to meet regional needs while staying aligned with global standards. This role will report into the our global Field Enablement team based in New York City and continue partnering with Field Enablement Managers globally across all regions and segments.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding for Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM.
  • Partner closely with Sales and CS leaders in Brazil and Mexico to understand performance needs and provide targeted enablement support.
  • Support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America who sell to LATAM customers.
  • Adapt and localize globally developed enablement programs to ensure relevance across language, culture, market context, and regional sales motions .
  • Design and facilitate reinforcement activities (e.g., role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that help sellers apply core concepts in real customer scenarios.
  • Collaborate closely with the Curriculum team to share field insights, provide feedback on program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of global content.
  • Track participation, collect feedback, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to assess enablement impact and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Build trusted relationships with Sales, Customer Success, and cross‑functional partners to diagnose challenges and recommend appropriate enablement interventions.
  • Act as a regional connector—surfacing LATAM‑specific insights back to global enablement teams to help shape future programs.

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role.
  • Experience supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; regional or international experience is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English (required).
  • Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions.
  • Solid business acumen and comfort working with performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions.
  • Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented—you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Command of the Message.
  • Foundational understanding of Datadog’s core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.
  • Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing region.
  • Scrappy and pragmatic—you enjoy building from the ground up and iterating as you go.
  • Willing and able to travel approximately 30% across Latin America and North America.

Why This Role Matters

As Datadog’s first Field Enablement hire in LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how enablement supports our sellers and Customer Success teams in the region. You’ll help ensure our global programs translate into local impact—accelerating ramp, improving confidence, and enabling teams to succeed with customers across a rapidly growing market.

Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people‑first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Vestacy é uma empresa independente (originada do carve-out da Reckitt) com um propósito claro: transformar casas em lares. Como parte do portfólio da Advent, uma das principais empresas globais de private equity, temos autonomia para inovar e acelerar nosso crescimento. Com quase 3.000 colaboradores em mais de 20 países, vemos cada pessoa como um Fundador, com poder para tomar decisões importantes e moldar o futuro.

Cuidamos do nosso negócio com a mesma dedicação que você tem pelo seu lar: com propósito, paixão e energia. Aqui, você encontrará espaço para liderar e inovar. Juntos, estamos construindo algo extraordinário.

A equipe de Digital Activation Hub da Vestacy é altamente especializada e dinâmica, atuando para conectar a estratégia de marketing à execução nas plataformas digitais. Estamos empenhados em impulsionar cada vez mais a inovação digital das nossas marcas, utilizando nossa expertise para garantir campanhas de alta performance.

Sobre a oportunidade

Nesta posição como Gerente de Retail Media, você atuará em estratégias para impulsionar a presença digital das nossas marcas em plataformas estratégicas como Amazon Ads, Mercado Livre (Mercado Ads), Google Ads, entre outros. Além disso, você irá colaborar com stakeholders internos e agências parceiras para garantir que nossas campanhas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, planejando ativações de Retail Media de forma estratégica e executando com excelência.

Esta posição abrange tanto estratégia quanto execução, abarcando desde o planejamento de ativações de mídia digital até a construção de campanhas em tempo real para maximizar resultados para as marcas e o negócio. Se você gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, orientado(a) a dados e é apaixonado(a) por inovação em retail media no mercado de consumo massivo, queremos te conhecer!

Suas responsabilidades:

Planejamento estratégico e tático (30% do papel)

  • Transformar insights de marca e audiência em planos de táticos de retail media e paid search, alinhados aos objetivos da campanha e às capacidades das plataformas.
  • Desenvolver calendários mensais e trimestrais de ativação, considerando períodos promocionais, lançamentos de produtos e eventos específicos de cada varejista.
  • Contribuir para a criação e atualização de guias de plataforma, incorporando aprendizados, melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades.
  • Apoiar na definição e distribuição de orçamento para otimizar investimento por plataforma, produto e período.

Execução e otimização (70% do papel)

  • Gerenciar a execução end-to-end de campanhas em Retail Media (Search & Display) e Paid Search (Google Ads, Meta), garantindo lançamentos no prazo e configurações corretas.
  • Monitorar diariamente a performance das campanhas, ajustando em tempo real para melhorar eficiência e atingir os KPIs.
  • Implementar melhores práticas de cada plataforma em segmentação, lançamentos e formatos criativos.
  • Explorar ferramentas e betas para aumentar a efetividade e manter-se atualizado(a) nas tendências de retail media.
  • Coordenar com times internos (marca, analytics, finanças) e com agências parceiras externas para alinhar execução com objetivos de marketing.
  • Realizar testes A/B e pilotos para identificar táticas escaláveis e melhorar produtividade.
  • Reportar métricas-chave (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e gerar insights.

Estamos em busca das seguintes vivências:

  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação Social e afins;
  • Experiência sólida na gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Amazon Ads e Mercado Livre, Google Ads, etc.
  • Conhecimento profundo em retail media, KPIs (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e otimização de campanhas.
  • Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados/KPIs para transformá-los em decisões estratégicas.
  • Vivência com definição estratégias de retail media, incluindo calendários sazonais, alinhamento promocional e segmentação de audiência.
  • Experiência colaborando com times multifuncionais (marca, vendas, analytics) e agências externas.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como DSPs, dashboards analíticos, Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: interesse em se manter atualizado sobre tendências e novidades em retail media.
  • Inglês avançado para conexão com times regionais e globais.

title: Desenvolvedor/a Cobol - Pleno
description:
Overview

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você. Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). Entregamos soluções sob medida com base nas necessidades específicas de cada negócio, a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com diferentes perfis, como especialistas em Dados, UX, até analistas de negócios e scrum masters.

#TechEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa/cursando nas áreas de Tecnologia, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharias e/ou correlatas;
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, principalmente Java e atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias de mercado;
  • Proficiência em Programação Cobol, JCL e Natural;
  • Ambientes de Desenvolvimento: Experiência com ambientes mainframe, como IBM z/OS;
  • Ferramentas de Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em DB2, Oracle ou outros bancos de dados relacionais, além de habilidades em SQL;
  • Ferramentas de Depuração: Familiaridade com ferramentas de depuração e análise de desempenho específicas para Cobol;
  • Controle de Versão: Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git ou SVN, para gerenciamento de código-fonte;
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Habilidade em trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban, para desenvolvimento colaborativo;
  • Inglês técnico.

Desejável

Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Experiência em integração de sistemas legados, familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento para Cobol, JCL e Natural;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, certificações relevantes e habilidades em testes e garantia de qualidade de softwares;
  • Certificações: IBM Certified Application Developer - COBOL, IBM Certified Professional in Business Analysis (CPBA), Micro Focus Certified Professional - COBOL.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento e Manutenção: Criar e manter aplicações em Cobol, JCL e Natural, garantindo a funcionalidade e eficiência do sistema;
  • Análise de Requisitos: Colaborar com equipes de negócios para entender e traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Trabalhar na integração de sistemas legados com novas tecnologias e plataformas;
  • Testes e Validação: Realizar testes de software para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das aplicações desenvolvidas;
  • Documentação: Produzir e manter documentação técnica e de processos para referência futura e conformidade.

O que oferecemos

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Wellhub, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

description:
Sobre Nós:

A Tako é uma plataforma unificada de operações de pessoas que se torna a fonte de inteligência das empresas brasileiras. Nascemos para resolver um dos maiores problemas do país: a burocracia que trava negócios e drena energia, inovação, empregos e bilhões da economia. É um problema difícil, mas que a Tako está resolvendo com uma plataforma baseada em aplicações determinísticas como a folha, dados e agentes de IA que executam o trabalho e enfrentam a burocracia diretamente, para modernizar as empresas e o país.

Além da nossa excelência técnica, visão de longo prazo e time excepcional, a Tako é suportada por founders com histórico de sucesso, um escritório em São Francisco e investidores como Ribbit Capital e a16z , que já aportaram mais de R$160M na empresa nas rodadas seed e série A - leia mais aqui.

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade de opiniões, histórias e experiências. Acreditamos que a troca construtiva é essencial para desenvolver soluções ousadas e relevantes .

Nosso time trabalha de forma presencial no nosso escritório no Itaim Bibi, São Paulo.

Sobre a posição:

Como Product Designer na Tako, você será responsável por transformar processos complexos de RH em soluções simples, intuitivas e visualmente impecáveis, facilitando a vida dos nossos usuários.

Acreditamos que podemos redefinir completamente a experiência de ferramentas B2B usando a combinação entre desenvolver nossa tecnologia, ter profundo entendimento do domínio e trazer uma abordagem centrada no usuário para todas as nossas decisões. O Product Designer tem um papel essencial nesse processo, colaborando diretamente com engenharia, operações e a liderança desde a priorização até a entrega e o acompanhamento dos resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Conduzir o processo de exploração, definição, desenho e especificação técnica de novas funcionalidades nos apps da Tako.
  2. Aprender rapidamente sobre temas complexos, entendendo todas as limitações e oportunidades, seja através de pesquisas técnicas, conversas com clientes ou conversas com especialistas.
  3. Documentar especificações técnicas (handoff) para os times de desenvolvimento e acompanhar o processo de implementação e release. Conseguir executar adaptações necessárias, simplificar escopo e melhorar a solução com os aprendizados ao longo do processo.
  4. Estar muito próximo dos usuários e do time de operações para coletar aprendizados e entender suas principais dores e necessidades.
  5. Desenvolver um profundo entendimento sobre o universo do departamento pessoal, os processos existentes e as restrições a serem contornadas.
  6. Criar visões de longo prazo que possam ser quebradas em múltiplas entregas que possam ser sequenciadas. Conseguir identificar onde estão as grandes entregas de valor e como simplificar o esforço necessário.
  7. Constantemente buscar melhorias na UX e na UI do produto existente, pensando em simplificar a experiência e garantir consistência. Compartilhar referências, questionar os pares, e realizar benchmarks de outros produtos para explorar boas práticas e oportunidades de melhorias.
  8. Conseguir estruturar e interpretar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas quando necessário.
  9. Participar das discussões estratégicas, decisões estruturais e definição de novas features, sempre com foco na melhor experiência para o usuário e evolução do produto.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em times ágeis, trabalhando lado a lado com os times de desenvolvimento durante o processo de implementação. Capacidade de gerir o próprio trabalho em ambientes com alto nível de autonomia.
  • Demonstrar UX e UI skills refinadas. Experiência prévia com apps mobile e software-as-a-service (SaaS) de grande escala é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de rodar o processo inteiro de uma nova funcionalidade ou melhoria, desde o discovery até o acompanhamento dos resultados.
  • Ter clareza no raciocínio, conseguir comunicar os aprendizados e as hipóteses por trás de cada proposta, buscar constantemente como simplificar a experiência e deixá-la mais intuitiva.
  • Ter visão analítica, conseguir interpretar métricas e resultados, derivar hipóteses e conclusões.

description:
About the Role

As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer in Core Services, you are a technical anchor for the foundational systems that power every Uber trip, delivery, and transaction globally. Your scope extends beyond a single team; you will define the 2-3 year technical vision for Uber’s backend ecosystem.

You will be responsible for the health, scalability, and evolution of our most critical infrastructure—Identity, Payments, and Safety—ensuring they remain resilient as we scale to the next 100 million users. You will act as a peer to Directors and VPs, providing the technical grounding for Uber's most ambitious business goals.

What You'll Do

  • Define the North Star: Lead the creation of a multi-year technical roadmap for Core Services, ensuring our architecture handles 10x growth while reducing systemic complexity.
  • Architectural Governance: Serve as a key member of the Architecture Review Board, setting standards for how backend services are built, deployed, and interconnected company-wide.
  • Buy vs. Build: Lead high-stakes evaluations for foundational technologies (databases, orchestration, messaging) that have long-term financial and operational impact.

Systems Transformation & Excellence

  • Solve the "Impossible": Directly tackle the most ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges that represent significant single points of failure for the company.
  • Institutionalize Reliability: Drive a company-wide shift toward "Zero-Trust" and "Always-On" architectures, re-engineering the platform to make entire classes of failures impossible.
  • Efficiency at Scale: Lead initiatives to optimize infrastructure spend and resource utilization across tens of thousands of nodes without compromising performance.

Cross-Functional & Industry Influence

  • Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership (VP/CTO level), translating complex technical trade-offs into business risks and opportunities.
  • Ecosystem Leadership: Represent Uber in the broader tech community (open source, conferences, standards bodies), positioning Uber's engineering as an industry gold standard.
  • Culture Carrier: Champion quality and long-term thinking, modeling Uber’s core values of "Go Get It" and "Build with Heart."

Mentorship of Leaders

  • Leader of Leaders: Focus mentorship on Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers, helping them grow into organizational leaders and strategic thinkers.
  • Sponsor Excellence: Identify and sponsor high-potential talent, ensuring a diverse and robust pipeline of future technical leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering massive-scale distributed systems.
  • History of Org-Wide Impact: Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformations that affect hundreds of engineers and multiple business units.
  • Deep Mastery of Distributed Theory: Expert-level understanding of CAP theorem trade-offs, consensus algorithms (Paxos/Raft), and global data consistency models.
  • Exceptional Communication: Ability to explain deep technical concepts to non-technical executives and build consensus across conflicting organizational priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Open Source Contribution: Significant contributions to major open-source projects in the infrastructure or distributed systems space.
  • Vertical Expertise: Deep experience in FinTech (Payments) or Identity/Security at a global "Big Tech" scale.
  • Future-Proofing: Experience migrating monolithic architectures to highly modular, cell-based, or serverless paradigms at scale.

Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuelds progress. What moves us, moves the world - let’s move it forward, together.

Quem somos nós?

A Boston Metal do Brasil é uma empresa inovadora e comprometida com a transformação da indústria de metais através de tecnologias sustentáveis. Queremos construir um futuro mais eficiente, seguro e inclusivo, valorizando as pessoas que fazem parte do nosso time.

Na Boston Metal, diversidade e inclusão são fundamentais para nossa missão e visão. Promover um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo é essencial não apenas para o nosso sucesso como empresa, mas também para impulsionar a inovação e a criatividade em nossa missão. Diversidade e Inclusão

Nosso Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência é parte do compromisso da Boston Metal do Brasil com a inclusão.

O que oferecemos?

Transforme a metalurgia e sua carreira

A Boston Metal do Brasil está revolucionando a produção metalúrgica, de forma sustentável, econômica e eficiente. A empresa trabalha para gerar valor e significado para investidores, colaboradores, clientes e comunidades em que está inserida.

Por meio da Eletrólise de Óxido Fundido (MOE, em inglês), uma tecnologia inovadora e disruptiva, estamos focados na produção de metais de alto valor, como nióbio, tântalo e estanho, essenciais para diversas indústrias.

  • Colaboração com o Time
  • Trabalhar junto a analistas sêniores nos levantamentos nas áreas de negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Conhecimento em SQL
  • Conhecimento EM Power BI
  • Conhecimento sobre AWS (Redshift, S3, Athena), GCP (BigQuery)
  • Conhecimentos sobre Google Analytics (GA4)
  • Noções sobre IA

Juntos por uma sociedade mais saudável

Somos RD Saúde, um ecossistema de saúde integral, com mais de 3 mil unidades em todo o Brasil e negócios em saúde que dividem o mesmo propósito: contribuir para uma sociedade mais saudável. Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais.

This gap leaves even the largest organizations potentially vulnerable to incidents they can’t directly control. That’s exactly where we step in.

Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility - combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas , pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Electrical Technician-Designer
description:
GMining Services is a multidisciplinary company which provides professional services in the mining industry for underground and open pit mining projects in precious, base, or industrial metals. G Mining Services is one of the most important mining engineering consulting firms in Quebec and among the leading firms renowned for their international projects.

GMining Services values its workforce by fostering professional and individual development through unique career opportunities, encouraging collaboration and offering a variety of stimulating challenges, all within a warm, welcoming, safe, and inclusive work environment.

To pursue its development, GMining Services is looking for a dynamic and motivated individual to fill the position of:

Summary of responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Lead Electrical Engineer, the incumbent will be part of the team dedicated to the electrical design and development of local and international mining projects. The incumbent will play an important role as the intermediary between Electrical Designers and Electrical Engineers. He/she will contribute, through his/her experience, to advise and support 3D modelling engineers at the electrical level. The main responsibilities include:

  • Prepare general, typical, and specific electrical layouts with the aim of harmonizing the construction phase of mine sites usually composed of process plants, power substations, transformers, underground and overhead power supplies, etc), both at the conceptual level and at the detail engineering (DE) level..
  • Conceptualize 3D models at the electrical level.
  • Review the data sheets
  • Prepare drawings of general arrangements and 2D equipment location according to project-specific electrical design and plant layout criteria.
  • Propose logical solutions and choices that respect the reality of other disciplines and departments involved in the construction of the mine site and its process plant (mechanical, earthworks, etc.);
  • Work with electrical engineers to select or recommend suppliers of electrical equipment that best meet the site’s needs.
  • Comment on supplier drawings to ensure accuracy of references and contact information.
  • Develop engineering files and electrical distribution system models, drawings, sketches and plans.

Requirements

  • Have a college diploma in electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • Have a minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience, including in electrical network design.
  • Experience in construction of mining projects and/or international projects is a strong asset.
  • Good knowledge of modelling software such as Plant 3D, REVIT and Autocad is an asset.
  • Ability to communicate in French and/or English.

Abilities

  • Good analytical, synthesis, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Good ability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Excellent organizational leadership skills.
  • Comfortable working in a constantly changing environment.
  • Autonomy and adaptability.

Additional information

  • Depending on the place of residence of the selected candidate, the position will be based at the G Mining Services office in Brossard, Canada or in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
  • Possibility of working in hybrid mode (office and remote work).
  • Possibility of traveling abroad and in Canada depending on the availability of the candidate.

If you feel ready and willing to be part of a team of experienced professionals, involved in various areas of the mining industry and driven by the desire to succeed in the projects in which they are involved, we offer you a challenge that matches your ambitions.

Benefits of being part of our team

G Mining cares strongly about the well-being of its employees so that they can thrive in all areas of their lives. The company’s family values are reflected across the range of benefits provided to our team members. By joining our team, you will get to enjoy the following benefits:

  • Bonus based on the employee's and the company's performance because we are committed to rewarding employee contributions.
  • Medical and dental insurance paid by G Mining.
  • Reimbursement program for sports-related expenses to keep you motivated to adopt healthy lifestyle habits.
  • Training program because we value the professional development of our employees.
  • Social activities to provide employees opportunities to have fun and connect with each other.

We look forward to reading your resume, which you are invited to send in complete confidentiality to the following e-mail address:

G Mining Services welcomes all submissions and is committed to evaluating them without discriminatory bias. We offer equal employment opportunities to all.

Knowledge of a language other than French is required for this position since G Mining Services’ clients are international and the incumbent will have to communicate with them on a regular basis.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About us:
JATO Dynamics is a global company and the leading provider of automotive market intelligence. With an insight into over 50 overseas markets, we deliver the world's most complete, accurate and up-to-date automotive data and insights, creating significant competitive advantage to our customers.

Find out more about what we do here: JATO

Our vision

Our vision is to be the world’s most exciting leader in automotive business intelligence solutions. We aim to generate excitement through implementing pioneering ideas, problem solving and going beyond our customer expectations. Our JATO colleagues are partners in our future and stakeholders in our desires. Our strategic intent is to help customers create significant competitive advantage by constantly leading in connected data, information and knowledge provision, ultimately improving our customers’ work processes, informed decision‑making and business results.

Role Overview

The successful candidate will research the local automotive market to gather accurate data on vehicle specifications using industry websites and publications. You will be responsible for regularly collecting, validating, and inputting pricing and specification data for new vehicles to support and enhance official datasets. In addition, you will play a key role in improving the overall quality and accuracy of the specifications database for the relevant market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain key contacts within the motor industry.
  • Liaise with automobile manufacturers and importers to collect data on a regular basis.
  • Actively find new and better ways of collecting information to help enhance the official price and specs data.
  • Liaise with other data suppliers, trade organisations, and dealers to gain additional information about the automobile industry.
  • Collaborate with other JATO staff to gather additional pertinent automobile data.
  • Input the data collected in the appropriate software on a daily basis.
  • Maintain a telephone/visit/inspections log for queries made at the manufacturers, as well as reporting the status of data collection on a regular basis.
  • Monitor the quality of the data on the local market and report any anomalies to the Production Department for correction.
  • Prepare news bulletins both in English and in the local language (where relevant) for the Company’s International Electronic News Service (JATONews).
  • Perform online web inspections at new/current sold vehicles and cross‑check with database to check inconsistences and improve quality of database.
  • Audit quality of information based in data sources and review checks within database in order to improve the accuracy of database and prevention of errors.

Key Requirements

  • Ability to process data accurately is essential.
  • Results‑driven with strong attention to detail.
  • Able to prioritise tasks and respond to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent English and local language skills.
  • Experience of structuring articles which must be submitted to our news service (JATO News) would be desirable.
  • Good IT skills (MS Excel, preferably also data input systems).
  • Ability to work independently.

The ideal candidate will preferably hold a third level education, with qualifications in economics, statistics, business studies, marketing, or similar. An engineering background would also be appropriate. A good command of both written and spoken English is essential as well as a keen interest in the automotive industry.

Our values

JATO core values are Integrity, People First, Collaboration, Innovation and Excellence.

Learn more about our values here: JATO Core Values

JATO Dynamics is a global business and our success is attributed to the diversity, skills and experiences of our colleagues across the world. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, sex, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, marital status or veteran status.

A Tako é uma plataforma unificada de operações de pessoas que se torna a fonte de inteligência das empresas brasileiras. Nascemos para resolver um dos maiores problemas do país: a burocracia que trava negócios e drena energia, inovação, empregos e bilhões da economia. É um problema difícil, mas que a Tako está resolvendo com uma plataforma baseada em aplicações determinísticas como a folha, dados e agentes de IA que executam o trabalho e enfrentam a burocracia diretamente, para modernizar as empresas e o país.

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade de opiniões, histórias e experiências. Acreditamos que a troca construtiva é essencial para desenvolver soluções ousadas e relevantes .

Nosso time trabalha de forma presencial no nosso escritório no Itaim Bibi, São Paulo.

Sobre a posição:

Como parte do primeiro time de Executivos de Contas da Tako, você terá a chance de impulsionar vendas em um estágio de rápido crescimento. Sua função será central no fechamento de novos negócios durante esta fase de expansão acelerada. Você se reportará diretamente ao nosso Head of Sales e será uma peça-chave na construção do nosso sucesso. Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado, pronto para superar desafios, atingir metas audaciosas e contribuir para a ambição da Tako de expandir significativamente nossa equipe de vendas em 2025 e acelerar nosso crescimento.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Alcançar e superar metas de vendas mensais, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento acelerado da Tako.
  2. Colaborar na construção e aprimoramento do nosso processo de vendas, com foco na agilidade e na eficiência, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com o time e os founders.
  3. Gerenciar as etapas do ciclo de vendas que é responsável, assegurando uma experiência positiva para o cliente em todas as interações.
  4. Trabalhar em conjunto com um time de Business Development Representatives para identificar e qualificar leads, otimizando o fluxo de oportunidades no ciclo de vendas.
  5. Realizar demonstrações do produto, destacando os diferenciais da Tako. Bem como, tornar-se um especialista no produto, compreendendo em profundidade nossa plataforma e o cenário competitivo.
  6. Cultivar e fortalecer relacionamentos com prospects-chave, estabelecendo confiança e conhecimento do setor.
  7. Compreender as necessidades dos clientes e coletar feedback detalhado, garantindo que essas informações sejam repassadas para a equipe interna, contribuindo para a evolução do nosso roadmap e das prioridades do produto.
  8. Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Marketing e pré-vendas para alinhar campanhas de geração de leads, otimizar o volume e a qualidade dos leads, desenvolver um pipeline de vendas saudável e melhorar conversões e SLAs.
  9. Alcançar consistentemente as metas de vendas estabelecidas.

Requisitos:

  • Capacidade de se ajustar e mudar de direção quando necessário.
  • Experiência com plataformas de CRM.
  • Experiência na negociação de contratos com executivos C-level para fechamento de oportunidades.
  • Abordagem programática para gerar e desenvolver leads dentro de suas contas designadas.
  • Capacidade de prosperar em um ambiente de trabalho extremamente dinâmico e acelerado.
  • Habilidade para aprender rapidamente sobre nosso produto, garantindo credibilidade em interações com prospects.

title: Minas Gerais abre concurso com 380 vagas para a área da saúde
description:
O Estado de Minas Gerais publicou o Edital SES nº 01/2026, que abre concurso público para o preenchimento de 380 vagas no cargo de Especialista em Políticas e Gestão da Saúde (EPGS), além da formação de cadastro de reserva. O edital foi divulgado no Diário Oficial do Estado nesta sexta-feira (16).

As vagas são destinadas à atuação na Secretaria de Estado de Saúde (SES-MG), tanto na unidade central, em Belo Horizonte, quanto nas Unidades Regionais de Saúde distribuídas pelo interior do estado.

O cargo de EPGS exige formação superior nas áreas especificadas no edital e prevê jornada de trabalho de 40 horas semanais, sob regime estatutário. A remuneração inicial, no Nível I, Grau A, é de R$ 4.287,02, composta por vencimento básico e Gratificação por Atividades de Gestão da Saúde (GAGES). Também está previsto o pagamento de ajuda de custo para alimentação por dia útil trabalhado, conforme a legislação estadual.

O edital prevê a possibilidade de isenção da taxa para candidatos que se enquadrem nos critérios estabelecidos em lei, como doadores regulares de sangue, mesários da Justiça Eleitoral, desempregados amparados pela legislação estadual e inscritos no Cadastro Único para Programas Sociais do Governo Federal (CadÚnico).

O concurso será realizado em duas etapas: prova objetiva de múltipla escolha e prova discursiva, ambas de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. As datas de aplicação das provas e o cronograma completo estão detalhados no edital.

O certame também prevê reserva de vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme a legislação estadual vigente.

As informações oficiais sobre o concurso, incluindo eventuais atualizações, devem ser acompanhadas no Diário Oficial do Estado e no site da banca organizadora.

We love the challenge of our industry. We’re changing lives and redefining success every step of the way.

Job Description

The Lead Data Manager will be responsible for all data management activities in large, complex studies under general supervision, or working under minimal supervision on data management activities for small to medium sized projects.

Communication

  • Primary communication point for project teams and company departments with regard to clinical data management
  • Communication line for clients/vendors for all data management aspects of clinical projects and clinical data management reporting

Data Management

  • Coordination of data management activities within clinical projects related to EDC development, data collection, cleaning, reconciliation, Database Lock, development of final integrated database and generation of final Data Management deliverables.
  • Primary responsibility for clinical data management activities within clinical projects, including, but not limited to:
    • Study documents review
    • Data Management plan and other project-specific guidelines and instructions development and review
    • Co-ordinate/perform user acceptance testing
    • Development of Data Validation Plan/Edit Check Specifications
    • Data entry coordination and supervision, feedback to data entry personnel regarding quality of data entry and other data entry issues
    • Data validation, including automatic and manual data inspections, data discrepancies/deficiencies review and resolution, query generation and resolution, feedback to clinical trial teams regarding quality of data
    • Non-CRF electronic data handling (receiving, archiving, loading into study database, review and resolution of reconciliation issues, feedback to vendors regarding quality of data and other issues)
    • Database edits (paper CRF studies)
    • Manual CRF review (non-medical checks)
    • Clinical database lock
    • Coordination and supervision of processing, dispatch and archiving of CRFs/queries
  • Input into design of CRFs and other data collection forms; review Case Report Form design for accuracy and adherence to protocol
  • Development of CRF completion guidelines
  • Coding medical data with coding dictionaries and coding listings review (Lead DMs with medical/biology background, additional training required)
  • SAE reconciliation
  • Electronic data transfer (import/export) specifications review and approval

Document Management

  • Liaison with Document Center with regard to maintenance of TMF and eTMF

Quality Control

  • Database QC checks performance and documentation
  • Shared responsibility for preparation and attendance at internal and client/third-party audits/inspections of Data Management
  • Shared responsibility for follow-up on and resolution of audit findings pertaining to Data Management

Training

  • Training of Assistant Data Managers
  • Project-specific training of investigators and clinical team in CRF completion

Corporate/Departmental Assignments

  • Investigator Meetings preparation/attendance
  • Meetings and teleconferences organized by client/vendor preparation/attendance

Qualifications

  • College or University degree or equivalent combination of training and experience that presents the required knowledge, skills and abilities
  • At least 3 years of experience of full scope of data management responsibilities in international EDC studies
  • At least 2 years of experience using CDM/EDC systems (Medidata Rave or Oracle Inform preferable)
  • Project data management experience is a plus
  • Full working proficiency in English
  • Organizational and managerial skills

Additional Information

Advance your career in clinical research and develop new skillsets whilst growing with the organization.
